_note: Policy knowledge base of the India Manufacturing Atlas (loaded by scripts/etl/load_policy.py). schemes = the 14 Production Linked Incentive (PLI) schemes and indicative BIS Quality Control Orders (QCOs); hs_prefixes are INDICATIVE 2-8 digit HS prefixes used to tag products and are not the legal product lists. agreements = India's trade agreements; partners are OEC country ids (countries.id); 'year' is the year of entry into force for in_force, of signature for signed and of launch/relaunch for negotiating. skill_councils = NSDC Sector Skill Councils mapped to Atlas sector ids and pilot value-chain ids. roadmap = the programme's Phase 0/I/II plan across the 8 workstreams, with status reflecting what THIS platform delivers. risks = the 6 programme risks with the platform control that implements each mitigation. Facts were compiled from public Government of India / PIB sources; unknown values are null and anything needing verification is flagged in 'source' or 'notes'.

schemes.name: PLI Scheme for Large Scale Electronics Manufacturing (Mobile phones and specified electronic components)
schemes.description: Incentive of 4-6% on incremental sales (over base year FY 2019-20) of mobile phones and specified electronic components manufactured in India, for five years.

agreements.name: India-Sri Lanka Free Trade Agreement
agreements.notes: Signed December 1998; in force from March 2000.

agreements.name: Agreement on South Asian Free Trade Area
agreements.notes: Signed 2004; in force from 1 January 2006. Bilateral trade with Pakistan has been largely suspended since 2019, so concessions to Pakistan are effectively inoperative.

agreements.name: India-Nepal Treaty of Trade
agreements.notes: Bilateral preferential trade treaty first concluded in 1991, revised in 2009 and renewed periodically - verify the current renewal.

agreements.name: India-Bhutan Agreement on Trade, Commerce and Transit
agreements.notes: Free-trade regime between India and Bhutan; current agreement signed in 2016 and in force from 2017 - verify dates.

agreements.name: India-Singapore Comprehensive Economic Cooperation Agreement
agreements.notes: In force from 1 August 2005; reviews have been held since.

agreements.name: ASEAN-India Trade in Goods Agreement
agreements.notes: Signed August 2009; in force from 1 January 2010 (phased by member). A joint review of AITIGA has been under way since 2023. Myanmar appears in OEC data as 'Burma' (asmmr).

agreements.name: India-Republic of Korea Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement
agreements.notes: In force from 1 January 2010; upgrade negotiations have been held - verify their status.

agreements.name: India-Japan Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement
agreements.notes: Signed February 2011; in force from 1 August 2011.

agreements.name: India-Malaysia Comprehensive Economic Cooperation Agreement
agreements.notes: In force from 1 July 2011.

agreements.name: Asia-Pacific Trade Agreement
agreements.notes: Originally the Bangkok Agreement (1975, in force 1976), renamed APTA in 2005; limited tariff preferences. Mongolia acceded later - verify the date.

agreements.name: India-MERCOSUR Preferential Trade Agreement
agreements.notes: Signed 2004; in force from 1 June 2009 with preferences on a limited set of tariff lines; expansion has been discussed.

agreements.name: India-Chile Preferential Trade Agreement
agreements.notes: In force from 2007 and expanded in 2017; negotiations towards a CEPA have been reported - verify.

agreements.name: India-Mauritius Comprehensive Economic Cooperation and Partnership Agreement
agreements.notes: Signed February 2021; in force from 1 April 2021. India's first trade agreement with an African country.

agreements.name: India-UAE Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement
agreements.notes: Signed February 2022; in force from 1 May 2022.

agreements.name: India-Australia Economic Cooperation and Trade Agreement
agreements.notes: Signed April 2022; in force from 29 December 2022. Negotiations on a broader Comprehensive Economic Cooperation Agreement (CECA) continue.

agreements.name: India-EFTA Trade and Economic Partnership Agreement
agreements.notes: Signed 10 March 2024 with Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway and Switzerland; entry into force reported from 1 October 2025 - verify. Liechtenstein has no separate OEC/BACI country id (its trade is reported with Switzerland).

agreements.name: India-United Kingdom Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement
agreements.notes: Signed 24 July 2025; entry into force depends on completion of domestic ratification procedures - verify current status.

agreements.name: India-European Union Free Trade Agreement
agreements.notes: Negotiations relaunched in June 2022 (with separate investment-protection and GI tracks); political conclusion of negotiations was reported in early 2026 but signature and ratification were pending - status kept conservative, verify. Cyprus is classified under Asia in OEC ids (ascyp).

agreements.name: India-Oman Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement
agreements.notes: Negotiations launched in November 2023; signature was reported in December 2025 - status kept conservative, verify.

agreements.name: India-New Zealand Free Trade Agreement
agreements.notes: Negotiations launched in March 2025; conclusion of negotiations was reported in December 2025 - status kept conservative, verify.

agreements.name: India-United States Bilateral Trade Agreement
agreements.notes: Negotiations on a multi-sector bilateral trade agreement began in 2025 - verify current status.

agreements.name: India-Gulf Cooperation Council Free Trade Agreement
agreements.notes: Framework agreement on economic cooperation signed in 2004; FTA negotiations have proceeded intermittently and were revived after 2022 - verify current status.

agreements.name: India-Eurasian Economic Union Free Trade Agreement
agreements.notes: Terms of reference for FTA negotiations were reported in 2025 - verify current status.

agreements.name: India-Canada Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement
agreements.notes: Talks launched in 2010 (with an Early Progress Trade Agreement track from 2022) and paused in 2023; resumption has been discussed - verify current status.

agreements.name: India-Israel Free Trade Agreement
agreements.notes: Negotiations launched in 2010 and held intermittently - verify current status.

roadmap.title: Platform architecture
roadmap.description: Modular API (FastAPI) + single-page dashboard (React) over one HSN-keyed database, with a scripted, repeatable ETL build.

roadmap.title: Digitize HSN codes with ministry mapping
roadmap.description: All current 8-digit lines of the GST HSN master on the WCO HS2022 hierarchy, with an indicative rule-based ministry mapping; DPIIT can upload the official Guidebook mapping.

roadmap.title: Search by HSN / product / ministry with drill-down
roadmap.description: Global typeahead search, HS tree from section to 8-digit line, faceted search and product pages.

roadmap.title: Load the official Guidebook mapping
roadmap.description: Upload, validation and apply pipeline is live; the official DPIIT mapping file has not been uploaded yet, so the mapping remains indicative.

roadmap.title: Guidebook dashboard
roadmap.description: KPI tiles, distribution by ministry, Enter-HSN lookup, ministry-wise HS table, sectoral distribution and info cards.

roadmap.title: Ministry-specific dashboards
roadmap.description: Each ministry sees its HSN codes, trade performance, domestic production (where available) and value-chain linkages.

roadmap.title: Downloadable reports
roadmap.description: PDF, XLSX and CSV reports for products, ministries, sectors, value chains and search results.

roadmap.workstream: Integrate Multi-Source Data at HSN Level
roadmap.title: Trade data: exports, imports, BCD, RCA
roadmap.description: CEPII BACI (via OEC) HS6 trade 2018-2024, partner and world-supplier detail, WITS/TRAINS MFN applied tariffs, RCA and shares.

roadmap.title: Access control, data ownership and audit
roadmap.description: Role-based access (public, industry, analyst, ministry, admin) with ministry-scoped rights and an audit log of every change.

roadmap.title: Phase plan and risk register
roadmap.description: Phase 0 / I / II tracker across the 8 workstreams, with a live risk and mitigation register.

roadmap.title: Sectoral deep-dives for 10 pilot sectors
roadmap.description: Tyre, natural rubber, cotton apparel, auto components, pharma APIs, mobile electronics, solar PV, steel, EV battery and leather footwear (plus toys).

roadmap.workstream: Build HSN Code - Value Chain Interlinkages
roadmap.title: Ministry-wise product mapping across value chains
roadmap.description: Stage-by-stage item tables with HS codes and concerned ministries (slides 14-17), linked to live 8-digit trade data.

roadmap.workstream: Build HSN Code - Value Chain Interlinkages
roadmap.title: Network graph of the manufacturing ecosystem
roadmap.description: One HSN to many inputs and outputs: interactive graph with upstream / downstream trace and critical-input highlighting.

roadmap.workstream: Build HSN Code - Value Chain Interlinkages
roadmap.title: Validate value-chain maps with industry experts
roadmap.description: Structured review of the curated chains with industry associations and line ministries; edge uploads are supported in the Data Hub.

roadmap.title: Export potential and untapped market estimation
roadmap.description: Export-potential score and untapped potential (US$) per HS6 with an opportunity matrix.

roadmap.title: Import dependency and substitution
roadmap.description: Dependency ratio, source concentration (HHI), China share and import-substitution scores.

roadmap.title: RCA-based competitiveness
roadmap.description: Balassa RCA distribution by sector and product.

roadmap.title: Demand-supply gaps
roadmap.description: Apparent consumption and self-sufficiency need domestic production in value terms; sourced figures are available for the pilot chains, with broader coverage still to come.

roadmap.workstream: Integrate Multi-Source Data at HSN Level
roadmap.title: Domestic production data from sectoral ministries
roadmap.description: Production upload template and validation are live; sectoral ministries have not yet supplied HSN-level production data.

roadmap.title: Policy use cases
roadmap.description: Import substitution, PLI targeting, trade negotiations (offensive / defensive interests), skilling and quality-control interventions.

roadmap.title: Tariff (BCD) scenario simulator
roadmap.description: Import, revenue and downstream input-cost effects of a tariff change, with all assumptions shown.

roadmap.title: Industry and Government interface
roadmap.description: Helpdesk where industry raises HSN-specific queries that are auto-routed to the owning ministry.

roadmap.title: Ownership of residual products
roadmap.description: Residual workbench where ministries claim unmapped codes and DPIIT approves the claims.

roadmap.title: Scale-up across all sectors
roadmap.description: Ministry and sector dashboards already cover every chapter; curated value chains still cover only the pilots, extended automatically by HS-text 'parts-of' links.

roadmap.title: AI/ML insights
roadmap.description: Supply-chain vulnerability index, k-means product archetypes and automated alerts for import-dependence hotspots.

roadmap.title: Predictive features: trade forecasts
roadmap.description: Two-year export and import forecasts per HS6 with uncertainty bands (model estimates).

roadmap.title: ML ministry suggestion for residual codes
roadmap.description: Text-similarity model suggests the likely owning ministry for each residual code.

roadmap.title: AI assistant over platform data
roadmap.description: Conversational assistant ('Ask Atlas', available on every page) that answers from the Atlas's own data with citations; works offline without an API key.

roadmap.workstream: Integrate Multi-Source Data at HSN Level
roadmap.title: Cross-validation and data confidence scores
roadmap.description: BACI values cross-checked against UN Comtrade; provenance labels and a data-quality score on every product.

roadmap.title: Automated refresh cycles
roadmap.description: Connectors for OEC (BACI), WITS and UN Comtrade run as admin-triggered refresh jobs; scheduled (cron) execution is not yet enabled.

roadmap.title: CBIC customs tariff API integration
roadmap.description: Live BCD and notification data at tariff-line level; needs CBIC / ICEGATE API access and credentials.

roadmap.title: GSTN HSN-wise domestic supply integration
roadmap.description: Aggregated HSN-wise outward supply as a domestic production / consumption signal; needs a data-sharing arrangement and credentials from GSTN.

roadmap.title: DGFT ITC-HS and trade data integration
roadmap.description: ITC-HS import / export policy conditions and official trade data; needs DGFT API onboarding and credentials.

roadmap.title: Public-facing module with controlled access
roadmap.description: Read-only public access for government, academia and industry; analytics, risk and data operations stay behind government roles.

roadmap.title: Secure, scalable cloud deployment
roadmap.description: Hosting on government-approved cloud infrastructure with load testing, encryption at rest and a security audit against government standards.

risks.risk: Multiple data sources (CBIC, GSTN, DGFT, Ministries) leading to inconsistencies and delays
risks.mitigation: Establish HSN-first data standard, build API-based pipelines, start with priority datasets
risks.platform_control: HSN-first keys: every table is keyed on the 8-digit HSN line or its HS6 with leading zeros. API connectors (OEC/BACI, WITS, UN Comtrade) run as tracked refresh jobs, ministry files go through validated CSV/XLSX uploads with row-level errors, and CBIC/GSTN/DGFT connectors are registered as not_configured until credentials exist. Trade and tariff data were integrated first as the priority datasets.

risks.risk: Incomplete/incorrect production, GST, and cluster data
risks.mitigation: Use AI-based data validation, cross-check datasets, introduce data confidence scores, start with high-confidence trade data
risks.platform_control: Every number carries provenance (Verified / Not verified / Not available); each product has a data-quality score and each mapping a confidence score. BACI trade is cross-checked against UN Comtrade, uploads are validated before an admin applies them, and missing production is shown as 'Not available' instead of being estimated.

risks.risk: Handling large database (12,000+ HSN codes) and real-time analytics
risks.mitigation: Deploy cloud-based scalable architecture (Google Cloud), use modular design, perform load testing, follow phased rollout
risks.platform_control: Modular design (independent API routers, ETL steps and connectors), precomputed metric and score tables, indexes and full-text search are designed to keep endpoints within a 1.5 s budget on the full database. Cloud deployment with load testing is a planned Phase II roadmap item.

risks.risk: Risk of sensitive data exposure or misuse
risks.mitigation: Implement role-based access control (RBAC), ensure encryption, follow government security standards, define clear access protocols
risks.platform_control: RBAC with five roles and ministry-scoped rights, signed expiring access tokens, salted PBKDF2 password hashing, and an audit log of every mutating action (logins, mapping changes, claims, uploads). Encryption at rest and a government security audit are part of the planned cloud deployment.

risks.risk: Difficulty in mapping input-output relationships across HSN codes
risks.mitigation: Start with pilot sectors, use AI/graph analytics, validate with industry experts, refine iteratively
risks.platform_control: Pilot chains first (eleven sectors), graph analytics (network BFS, upstream/downstream trace, critical inputs), HS-text 'parts-of' links that extend the graph automatically, and value-chain edge uploads so experts can refine the maps iteratively.

risks.risk: Trying to cover all sectors and features at once
risks.platform_control: Phased roadmap tracker (Phase 0 / I / II) with status per item and admin-editable progress, plus this live risk register, so scope is added phase by phase.
